description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance metric CoLeG-E (%) across three different language models under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis displays the model categories, ordered from left to right as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-E (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to just above 50, with visible numeric tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 50; a grey rectangular artifact obscures the area where the 40 tick mark would typically appear. The data is presented in groups of four side-by-side bars for each model category, with each bar representing a specific training condition as defined by the legend. The "no SFT" condition is represented by light blue bars with top-left to bottom-right diagonal white hatching. The "+ SFT on D0" condition is shown as light orange bars with horizontal white hatching. The "+ SFT on D0, D1" condition uses light purple bars with bottom-left to top-right diagonal white hatching. Finally, the "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" condition is depicted with solid light pink bars. Across all three model categories, the bar heights consistently increase from left to right within each group. The shortest bar in the chart is the "no SFT" condition for LLaMA-2-7B at approximately 4%, while the tallest bar is the "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" condition for LLaMA-2-70B at approximately 50.5%. Other approximate values include the LLaMA-2-13B group ranging from 8.5% for "no SFT" to 39% for "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2", and the LLaMA-2-70B "no SFT" bar at 26.5%. The categories on the horizontal axis are sorted by increasing model parameter size, and the first three bars in each group are visually emphasized with distinct white hatching patterns, whereas the fourth bar remains solid.
